answer_1.quote: In this work, we evaluated the ability of GPT models to generate dialogue summaries that adhere to human guidelines...

answer_2.quote: We reported the F1 scores of ROUGE-1/2/L ... We also reported the F1 scores of BERTScore ... Using DeepSeek-R1 as the backbone for automatic evaluation on a subset of model predictions

answer_3.quote: Using DeepSeek-R1 as our evaluation backbone, we evaluated the generated summaries against the human summarization guideline criteria

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation using criteria derived from the annotation guidelines ... three native French speakers ... assign a score from 1 to 5 based on its compliance with the specific criterion
answer_4.guideline: Evaluation criteria derived from the human summarization guidelines: Faithfulness, Main Issues, Sub-Issues, Resolution
